name: The fade under 85k
shots: /cases/oct21-fade.webp
Seven hours under the 85k ask stack, then the slide to 81.9k.
read: The push into 84.8k squeezed shorts on the way up, and OI dropped during it. The fuel was burned before price reached the wall.
Seven hours under a thick ask stack at 85.0k and above. Five tests of the high, a wide and loose range, then a lower high around 23:00.
Losing the 84.1k bids, followed by about $13M of long liquidations.
Price fell all morning while OI climbed. That is new shorts pressing. It based around 81.5k to 82k.
lesson: Leaning on a wall is not enough. Check whether the squeeze already happened on the way there.

name: The dump through 80k
shots: /cases/oct29-dump.webp
Top under 82k, loss of the 81,196 line, the shelf, then the flush.
read: The pump topped under asks at 82k, then lost the 81,196 line. OI bled for 90 minutes as longs left.
A two-hour shelf at 80.7k to 80.9k with lower highs. Many bids between 79k and 80k had left the book when price rallied away earlier.
The break of the shelf at 20:00.
lesson: The first liquidation spike was a scalp. The bounce pulled OI back up and trapped dip buyers under 80k.

name: The rally off 76.5k
shots: /cases/oct30-rally.webp
Second flush at 00:15, quiet low at 02:05, POC reclaim, rally to the breakdown shelf.
read: A second $48M flush at 00:15 cleaned out the trapped dip buyers, and OI collapsed.
The final low at 76.5k came on almost no liquidations and no delta, right on a bid that had sat there for hours.
Price reclaimed the 77.25k POC and held on top of it for 40 minutes.
It stalled at 78.5k to 78.7k, the shelf where the second flush started.
lesson: The durable low was the quiet third push, after OI had reset. It was not the big liquidation candle.

name: The pump to 81.2k
shots: /cases/nov04-pump.webp
Flush into the 76k bid, six hours under 78.2k to 78.6k, then the squeeze.
read: Price flushed into a thick bid at 76k on heavy sell delta and long liquidations, then reclaimed 76k within two candles.
It sat directly under heavy asks at 78.2k to 78.6k for six hours and never got rejected.
The reclaim of 76k for the early entry. The break over 78.6k for the late one.
$106M of short liquidations and an OI spike, straight into the heaviest asks at 81k and above.
lesson: A tight range with higher lows under a wall, with the short liquidations still above it, is the version that breaks.

name: The round trip down
shots: /cases/nov05-dump.webp
Lost POC at 80.5k, the weak shelf, then the fall through the thin zone.
/cases/nov04-07-roundtrip.webp
Nov 4 to 7 in one view: the pump and the dump through the same thin zone.
read: OI bled out for hours after the pump while price went flat under 81.2k. Nobody new was buying.
It lost the 80.5k POC, the 79.9k bid got eaten, then a weak shelf formed at 79.6k to 79.8k.
About $45M of long liquidations into the thick 75.0k to 75.2k bid, which held.
lesson: A pump that leaves a thin zone behind can be retraced through that zone just as fast.

name: The Sunday nuke
shots: /cases/nov08-nuke.webp
All-day range under 76.1k, lost POC, then the flush and the V.
read: An all-day range capped by an ask at 76.1k. It lost the 75.85k POC around 17:00 and every retest from underneath failed.
Lower highs through the evening and a slow bleed toward the range low.
The break of the range low near 75.6k.
$92M of long liquidations, and the wick was bought back inside the same candle.
lesson: Sunday night book. The stacked bids below vanished on the way down, and the liquidation spike was a straight V.

name: The 73k sweep
shots: /cases/nov10-arrows.webp
The rejection at 74.85k, the flush, and the rally back.
/cases/nov10-heatmap.webp
Closer view of the book: bids at 73k, 72.9k and 72.75k get hit, the 72.5k wall is never reached.
/cases/nov10-profile.webp
15m profile view: the wick low from Nov 8 and the 74.75k POC shared by two sessions.
read: The rally into 74.85k came on rising OI, tagged the two-day POC at 74.75k, printed short liquidations at the high and got rejected.
The biggest sell delta came on the first leg to 73k, with about $20M of long liquidations. The lower low at 72.7k came on much smaller delta and liquidations, and OI ticked up there (late shorts).
The reclaim of 73.5k, the swept low from Nov 8.
The rally ran on falling OI and flat CVD, which is short covering. At 21:10 it was pushing into the thickest asks at 74.0k to 74.2k.
lesson: The 13:30 sweep of the same level gave the same signal, tagged the POC and then failed. Take profit at value.
